skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target, plus bonus damage equal to 5% of own max HP.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in the entire row with 3 consecutive hits dealing 44% ATK DMG each, with a 50% chance to inflict [Burn] on the target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 80% ATK).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Strikes each enemy in the entire row with 3 consecutive hits dealing 55% ATK DMG each, with a 75% chance to inflict [Burn] on the target for 2 turns (DoT equal to 80% ATK).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When an enemy takes DoT, immediately absorbs 50% of that DoT value to deal extra damage to all enemies (only 1 effect of the same type works throughout the whole battle).

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When an enemy takes DoT, immediately absorbs 70% of that DoT value to deal extra damage to all enemies (only 1 effect of the same type works throughout the whole battle).

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When an enemy takes DoT, immediately absorbs 75% of that DoT value to deal extra damage to all enemies (only 1 effect of the same type works throughout the whole battle).

effects.desc: Continuous fire damage over time to the target.
